sports.body: South Africa’s innings win over Australia has tightened the World Test Championship final race. They also need at least two of Australia, New Zealand and South Africa to drop points.

sports.body: Mona Agarwal won her second gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games on Friday. She achieved a world record score of 357.5 in the women’s 50m rifle 3 Positions SH1 final. This victory adds to her previous gold in the women’s 10m air rifle standing SH1 event. India's para shooting team stands strong with 103 medals, aiming to surpass their best performance.

sports.body: Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the second T20I against New Zealand due to a low-grade injury. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, a promising teenager, could make his return to the playing XI. India secured a record-breaking chase in the first T20I, leading the series 1-0. The BCCI medical team is monitoring Kishan's recovery while discussing potential replacements. The upcoming match is set to take place at Hagley Oval in Christchurch.

city.title: Indian-origin siblings sold cookies in 2018; charity gave 100,000 books
city.body: Rohan and Anya Satija initiated the Let's Learn Foundation to provide books and mental health support. They began their efforts with a lemonade stand in 2018, raising awareness about educational inequalities. The foundation has since reached over 15,000 students across Texas and partnered with various organizations for resources. Their mission continues to focus on underserved communities to ensure equitable access to education.

His remarks have led to significant backlash from various groups regarding his mixed heritage.
